name: test-kit-marketplace
description: A marketplace hosting the testing-suite plugin: stack-aware test generation skills for Flutter, React, Next.js, Swift/SwiftUI, and Node/Express.

plugins.name: testing-suite
plugins.description: Five platform-specific skills (Flutter, React, Next.js, Swift, Node/Express) that detect a project's stack, audit its existing test conventions, and write unit/widget/integration/golden tests with boundary-only mocking. Running and verifying the tests -- including a fault-injection self-check -- is available on request.
